sentences.en: [Scene 1: Friday evening at the cafe]
[Bob] Congratulations on your promotion! You earned it.
[Alice] Thank you so much, Bob. It still doesn't feel real.
sentences.ko: 정말 고마워, Bob. 아직 실감이 안 나.

sentences.en: [Bob] I knew everything would work out for you.
sentences.ko: 난 다 잘 풀릴 줄 알았어.

sentences.en: [Bob] I'm so proud of how far you've come.
sentences.ko: 네가 이만큼 해낸 게 정말 자랑스러워.

sentences.en: [Alice] That means the world to me.
sentences.ko: 그 말이 정말 큰 힘이 돼.

sentences.en: [Bob] Let's go out for dinner to celebrate.
[Alice] Yes! This calls for a celebration!
[Scene 2: Monday morning at the new office]
[Alice] I like to plan out my day over breakfast.
sentences.ko: 저는 아침을 먹으며 하루 일정을 짜는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.en: [Alice] Let me settle in before we get started.
[Bob] Take your time. I usually get to the office around nine.
sentences.ko: 천천히 해. 나는 보통 아홉 시쯤 사무실에 도착해.

sentences.en: [Alice] I need to go over my emails first thing.
sentences.ko: 제일 먼저 이메일을 쭉 살펴봐야 해요.

sentences.en: [Bob] Sounds good. Let's kick off the meeting in ten minutes.
[Scene 3: After work at the hair salon]
[Cathy] Welcome! What are we doing today?
sentences.ko: 어서 오세요! 오늘 어떻게 해 드릴까요?

sentences.en: [Alice] I'd like a trim, please.
[Alice] Could you take a little off the sides?
[Alice] I'm thinking of going for a fresh look.
[Cathy] Great! Would you like to try our color treatment too?
sentences.ko: 좋아요! 컬러 트리트먼트도 같이 해 보실래요?

sentences.en: [Alice] I'd love to, but I'll have to pass this time.
[Cathy] We also have a deep conditioning add-on.
[Alice] I appreciate the offer, but it's not for me.
sentences.ko: 제안은 감사하지만 저랑은 잘 안 맞을 것 같아요.

sentences.en: [Scene 4: Next morning at the gym]
[Dan] Morning! Haven't seen you in a few days.
[Alice] I'm trying to get in shape this year.
sentences.ko: 올해는 몸을 좀 만들어 보려고 해요.

sentences.en: [Alice] I usually work out before breakfast.
sentences.ko: 저는 보통 아침 먹기 전에 운동해요.

sentences.en: [Alice] My muscles are sore from yesterday's workout.
[Dan] That's a good sign. First time here?
[Alice] Oh no, I'm a regular at this gym.
[Alice] I'm trying to keep up with my routine.
sentences.ko: 제 루틴을 잘 지키려고 노력하는 중이에요.

sentences.en: [Dan] Stick with it. You'll see results soon!
